It should be installed in the middle of the two F Holes. 2. When you receive the bow and the hairs are loose, don't worry. Use the screw to tighten the frog so that the hair has tautness. 3. When you find that part of the bow hair is broken, it is normal, please cut off the broken part and the bow can be used normally. 4. Be careful to not over tighten your bow. The hair should have a slight bounce to it without touching the stick after placing it on the strings. Usually about 1/4 of an inch distance from the low point of the curve to the hair is ideal. 5. Hold the rosin with your index finger and thumb, and thus tighten up the bow, evenly smear the rosin on the bowstring up and down. Suggested use: before smearing, rip a trace on rosin to make it powdery for quick and even smearing. Try to keep your hands away from rosin or pad with a tissue while smearing; otherwise it will become too sticky to clean. 6. If the string falls out, don't worry, it can be reinstalled, please consult customer service.

IMPORTANT GUIDELINES FOR SAFE AND EFFICIENT SEWING:

SAFETY REMINDER: This sewing machine is not intended for use as a toy. Please ensure that children do not operate it.

STITCHING ADJUSTMENT :If you notice loose stitching, gently tighten the upper elastic button.

DEALING WITH BROKEN THREAD: In case of a broken thread while sewing, adjust the tension by loosening the upper thread elastic button. Additionally, check for threading errors in the upper thread.
ADDRESSING KNOTS: If the bottom thread knots during sewing, verify the correct order of the upper thread threading.

THREAD ALIGNMENT CHECK: If the bottom thread is not catching on the upper thread, confirm that the sewing needle is threaded in the correct direction.

FABRIC CONSIDERATIONS: Sewing soft and stretchy fabrics, such as gauze and towels, may yield less optimal results.

POWER SUPPLY CAUTION: Choose only one power supply type; using both may result in the machine not running or sustaining damage!

Cordless Portable Blender For Shakes & Smoothies, Personal Juicer Cup,  BPA-Free Bottle With LED Display, Self-Cleaning Ice Crusher
products.body_html:
1. FOUR SPEED MODES, ONE CUP FOR EVERYTHING This 2-in-1 blender and juicer gives you four gear settings matched to four blending times. Smoothies, protein shakes, fresh juice, baby food and frozen drinks all come out silky. One button, one cup, done.

2. 22,000 RPM MOTOR + SELF-CLEANING A high-torque motor spins up to 22,000 RPM to break down ice and frozen fruit in seconds, and it runs quietly. Add water, tap self-clean, and the cup rinses itself. No scrubbing, no soaking.

3. TRIPLE SAFETY PROTECTION It shuts off on its own after 5 seconds of idling, stops the moment something jams the blades, and will not start at all unless the cup is locked onto the base. Safe even when you are half asleep at 6 a.m.

4. FOOD-GRADE AND BPA-FREE Food-grade PP + ABS cup, 12 food-grade stainless steel blades, BPA-free throughout. No plastic smell, no aftertaste, and nothing leaching into your morning smoothie.

5. LIGHTWEIGHT WITH LONG BATTERY LIFE Only 490 g, and shaped to sit in a bag or a car cup holder. Long-lasting fast-charge battery with an LED display that shows the remaining charge. Top it up from a wall adapter, a car charger or a power bank.

Product Description

Fresh smoothies, anywhere.

This cordless portable blender packs a 22,000 RPM motor, 12 food-grade stainless steel blades and a 450 ml BPA-free cup into one lightweight body you can carry in one hand.

Four speed modes let you match the blend to the job — a few seconds for a quick protein shake, longer for ice and frozen fruit.

The LED display keeps an eye on the battery level. The self-cleaning mode means you add water, tap, and you're done.

Safety is built in. It stops on its own after 5 seconds of idling. It stops instantly if anything jams the blades. And it won't start until the cup is locked onto the base.

At 490 g it slips into a backpack, a gym bag or a car cup holder. Charge it from a wall outlet, a car charger or a power bank.

Breakfast at home. A shake after the gym. Juice at the office. Anytime, anywhere.
